author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
The long-awaited return to Adam's Vault build! 18 months after the last update, Adam disassembles and lays out all the parts of his miniature bank vault door to explain the mechanical roadblock that halted his progress. And so begins work on the next crucial part: a tiny dial that'll be the way he gets the combination lock to actually work!
